ecosystem:primitives.comment: Just a floor of cubes. Allow grey flowers from primitives. The ecosystem starts bare.

ecosystem:transformation.comment: Allow some static movement in the ecosystem. Flowers/elements can shift position.

ecosystem:color.comment: Allow color in the ecosystem. Grey flowers gain color.

ecosystem:forces.comment: Allow some force in the ecosystem. Elements react to forces.

ecosystem:arraytutorial.comment: Allow arrays of flowers. Flowers can appear in ordered groups/patterns.

ecosystem:wavefunctions.comment: Allow sine math form in the ecosystem. Wave-shaped growth patterns.

ecosystem:randomness.comment: Allow random space in the ecosystem. Placement and variation become stochastic.

ecosystem:noise.comment: Allow noise voxels and noise terrain. The ground itself becomes a noise landscape.

ecosystem:cellularautomata.comment: Allow growth — small game of life ecosystem. Plants spread and die by local rules.

ecosystem:fractals.comment: Allow procedural fractal flowers and trees. Self-similar branching at every scale.

ecosystem:lsystems.comment: Allow L-system flowers and trees. Grammar-driven plant growth becomes the world.

ecosystem:proceduralgeneration.comment: Allow procedurally generated ecosystem elements. The world generates itself.
